messages.content: improve maintaining an academic tone: The irreversible anthropogenic alteration of the Earth's biophysical systems (Witze, 2024), observable in geomorphology (Nixon, 2011), has received terminological recognition through the neologism 'Anthropocene' (Moore, 2016), coined by Stoermer and Crutzen in 2000 (Nixon, 2011). Their revision of geological nomenclature (Smith & Zeder, 2013); proposing the 'Anthropocene epoch' to supersede the Holocene (Haraway, 2016), aims to highlight the unprecedented biophysical species power attained by the Anthropos from the industrial era onward (Nixon, 2011).
